pages.quiz:
INTEGRATED SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Electrical Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Electrical Energy.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Electrical Energy.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Electrical Energy.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Mixtures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mixtures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mixtures.

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. watt (W)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Magnetism? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Magnetism.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Magnetism.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Magnetism.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Acids, Bases and Indicators? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Acids, Bases and Indicators.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Acids, Bases and Indicators.

7. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Human Excretory System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Human Excretory System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Human Excretory System.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Human Excretory System.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laboratory Safety? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Laboratory Safety.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laboratory Safety.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laboratory Safety.

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Overgrazing continuously

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

12. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only water vapour
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Magnetism and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Integrated Science and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory Safety and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Laboratory apparatus and instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

2. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Electrical Energy.

3. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mixtures.

4. C — newton (N)

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Magnetism.

6. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Acids, Bases and Indicators.

7. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

8. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Human Excretory System.

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laboratory Safety.

10. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

11. B — 100 °C

12. C — Glucose and oxygen

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Magnetism; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Laboratory Safety; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
